data.summary: Amtsgericht Exempelsund (Mahngericht) issued an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid) in the case "Beispielauto Leasing GmbH gegen Sie", declaring enforceable a total claim of €748.71 (unpaid leasing instalments for August and September 2026 plus interest and costs), after no objection (Widerspruch) was filed against the earlier payment order (Mahnbescheid).
data.explanation: A court has declared Beispielauto Leasing GmbH's claim against you legally enforceable, equal to a default judgment, because you did not object to the earlier Mahnbescheid. You may still file an objection (Einspruch) with Amtsgericht Exempelsund, but only within the deadline shown by the app, and it cannot be extended. If you do nothing, the creditor can start enforcement measures (e.g. against your wages or bank account) for the full amount. Consider paying the amount if the debt is correct, or get legal advice quickly if you dispute it.
